notes:
Opening an existing project. Browsing happens in-app rather than through the native folder picker, because a browser never reveals an absolute path to the page and the daemon could not act on the selection. Folders that already hold a project are badged.

CHR-831: the path row carries a "+ New folder" button (`$new-folder-btn`) right of the breadcrumbs. Click opens an inline row at the top of the list; see `open-project-dialog-new-folder` and its `-exists` / `-created` states.
